bullets.text: Cut p99 latency of the ticket-search API by 45% by redesigning its caching layer (Redis, Go).
Led migration of 30+ services from a monolith to Kubernetes with zero customer-facing downtime.
Mentored 4 engineers; two were promoted within 18 months.
Introduced contract tests & on-call runbooks, reducing incident count by 30% year over year.
Built a Django + PostgreSQL billing service processing EUR 2M/month.
Wrote ETL pipelines in Airflow feeding the company's analytics warehouse (~50 GB/day).
Added type hints and CI checks (mypy, ruff) across a 120k-line codebase.
Prototyped a log-parsing CLI in Python used by 3 internal teams.

cover_letter.subject: Application for Staff Backend Engineer
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Staff Backend Engineer role at Example Corp. Your focus on low-latency APIs at scale matches the work I've done for the past seven years.

At Railwise I cut p99 latency of our ticket-search API by 45% and led the migration of 30+ services to Kubernetes with zero customer-facing downtime. Before that, at DataNest, I built a billing service processing EUR 2M/month.
I also enjoy growing engineers: I've mentored four, two of whom were promoted within 18 months. I'd bring the same mix of hands-on delivery and team support to Example Corp.
Thank you for your time. I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can help your platform team.
